name: summarize-pro
author: 诺声(Logos)@SynomosAI
purpose_en: Turns a transcript, recording or long document into minutes, a comparison table, a timeline, bullets or cards — choosing the format by reader intent, then compressing under a no-hallucination discipline.
purpose_zh: 把录音、会议转写或长文档变成纪要、对比表、时间线、要点或卡片——先按读者用途选格式，再在「不编造」纪律下压缩。每个数字与日期都能回溯到原文，模糊处只标注不替用户裁决。
use_when_en: Use when the user asks for meeting minutes, a decision log, action items, a comparison table, a timeline, key points or a digest of a long transcript.
use_when_zh: 当用户要会议纪要、决议记录、待办清单、对比表、时间线、要点提炼，或要把长转写压成简报时使用。
outputs_en: A minutes/brief markdown file plus facts.json; citecheck reports how many facts are traceable and lists the untraceable ones.
outputs_zh: 一份纪要/简报 markdown 与 facts.json；citecheck 报告可溯源事实数与不可溯源清单。
